verses.id: Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pengasih, Maha Penyayang
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

verses.id: Segala puji bagi Allah, Tuhan seluruh alam
verses.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense

verses.id: Hanya kepada Engkaulah kami menyembah dan hanya kepada Engkaulah kami mohon pertolongan
verses.en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help
Guide us to the straight path

verses.ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.tr: Sirata allatheena anAAamta AAalayhim ghayri almaghdoobi AAalayhim wala alddalleena
verses.id: (yaitu) jalan orang-orang yang telah Engkau beri nikmat kepadanya; bukan (jalan) mereka yang dimurkai, dan bukan (pula jalan) mereka yang sesat
verses.en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray
